caption: The drawing features a central red circle containing a white six-pointed star, surrounded by a red ring within the circle. The red circle sits at the intersection of a green cross, which extends both vertically and horizontally, dividing the central shape into four quadrants. Each arm of the green cross contains a row of small white triangles pointing toward the center, bordered by green on the outside. Behind the cross and partially visible from the center, there is a larger red semi-circle on each side, with the curved edge facing outward; along the edge of these semi-circles are white isosceles triangles, creating a zigzag pattern. The entire composition is set on a light beige background, with the geometric forms sharply delineated. The image is symmetrical both horizontally and vertically.
title: Quilt
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
